prompt: Port Sokoban to the web engine with arrow keys and restart. Compare every accepted and rejected action, terminal state, and displayed goals against reference traces.

materials.rule_note: Only push one box into empty floor; reject blocked pushes without mutation.

evaluation_protocol.scope: Both arms receive these exact evaluation conditions. Numeric choices absent from v0.1 are explicit v0.2 benchmark design choices, not inferred original requirements.
evaluation_protocol.claim_policy: TIMEOUT is not UNSOLVABLE; bot outcomes are not human ratings; missing observations remain unmeasured.

submission_contract.accepted_runtime: Engine-native createGame({content,seed}) exposing snapshot/step or a toolkit adapter to that same public boundary. GameSpec is never mandatory.
submission_contract.snapshot: JSON tick>=0 integer, terminal:null or {status,reason}; task-observable fields with an evaluator-owned alias map.
submission_contract.action: Public action objects; direction, swap, place, pour, move/fire, and phase actions are normalized by the evaluator.
submission_contract.evidence: Trusted supervisor captures build, native transitions, every episode, every generation attempt, source hashes, and old/new regression traces. Model-authored pass booleans have no evidentiary value.
submission_contract.review: Semantics, assumptions, human experience, and unprovided source claims receive explicit blind manual review, never automatic keyword scores.
submission_contract.normalization_rule: Native field/event names can differ; supervisor maps aliases from inspected source. Never manufacture missing events or infer order from a final screenshot. Controlled fixture content can supply initial positions, board, pieces, or declared initial_snapshot. No private GameSpec or treatment RNG stream is required.
